title: Nano-cobalt anchored on chitosan-derived N-doped porous carbon: an efficient catalyst for α-alkylation of ketones with alcohols via borrowing hydrogen
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23673-23683
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01776B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zegang Zhang, Dongbin Mo, Youjuan Tan, Xueqin Chang, Lin Chen, Xianglin Pei
Using modified chitosan microsphere precursors, an N/O-doped porous carbon supported cobalt catalyst (QNCM@Co) was prepared, which exhibits high activity, broad substrate scope and good cycling stability in the α-alkylation of ketones with alcohols.
